report_metadata.title: OMNIVERSEOS 2.0 MASTER AUTONOMOUS FORENSIC RE-AUDIT & PRODUCT EVOLUTION REPORT

executive_summary.rationale: Zero P0 defects, zero P1 defects unresolved. All 32 desktop applications verified via live browser automation with zero crash boundaries. All 32 mobile applications verified across 5 responsive viewports (320px, 375px, 390px, 430px, 768px) with zero horizontal overflow. User uncommitted Windows Phone revamp (Metro live tiles, search filter, soft navbar, task switcher) verified 100% operational. All 15 AI cognitive applications evaluated across 10-point Zero-Trust suites (150 unique tests, zero crash, zero canary leak). Pytest backend suite passing 100% (29 passed, 1 skipped). Jest frontend suite passing 100% (20 suites, 82 passed). 24/24 AI forensic end-to-end tests passed. All 5 logged defects (DEF-001 through DEF-005) resolved in source code and regression verified.
